claims.text: Collection API responses (create, view, list, update) serialize the collection's id, name, type, API rules (with null and empty-string rules distinguished), fields with their options, and indexes exactly as configured.
Auth collection responses include the auth-specific options (such as passwordAuth and oauth2 with provider names and clientIds) but never expose secrets such as OAuth2 client secrets.
View collection responses include the viewQuery, and base collection responses do not include auth-only or view-only options.
